sections.routesDescription: Define the Method, Path, Host, and Upstream forwarding rule exposed to callers.
sections.productsDescription: Organize publishable API capabilities with Products and Versions.
sections.upstreamsDescription: Manage internal API Services and restricted external HTTPS services that the Gateway can reach.
sections.revisionsDescription: Platform saves a new immutable snapshot only when the effective traffic configuration changes; identical configuration reuses the active snapshot. This page is for audit and rollback only.
sections.workspacesDescription: Isolate API Products, Upstreams, Environments, and runtime snapshots.

empty.routesDescription: Create a Product and Upstream, then bind a public path to the upstream service.
empty.productsDescription: Create the first API Product. Its initial Version becomes publishable immediately.
empty.upstreamsDescription: Connect the Node API Service in this Workspace or add a restricted external HTTPS service.
empty.revisionsDescription: Publish the first Service Endpoint from the endpoint catalog and Platform will save the initial runtime snapshot automatically.
empty.workspacesDescription: Create a Workspace and its default Environment to begin organizing APIs.

upstreamKinds.internalDescription: The Platform injects the Service Token
upstreamKinds.externalDescription: Only safe public HTTPS addresses are allowed

workspaceForm.title: Create Workspace
workspaceForm.description: Create an isolated API management space and initialize its first Environment.
workspaceForm.editDescription: Update the Workspace name and stable slug. Change its status from the list.
workspaceForm.environmentDescription: Each Environment owns an independent active runtime snapshot. Start with development, then add staging and production later.
workspaceForm.defaultDomainHelp: Optional. Routes without their own Host use this domain. Only one Environment may leave it empty as the lowest-priority any-Host fallback.
workspaceForm.boundaryTitle: A Workspace is a management boundary, not another service
workspaceForm.boundaryDescription: It only isolates Products, Upstreams, Routes, Environments, and runtime snapshots. It does not add another process to deploy.

environmentForm.description: Configure an independent domain and active runtime snapshot for {workspace}.

productForm.title: Create API Product
productForm.description: Create a Product and its first Version. Multiple Routes can later belong to the same Version.
productForm.editDescription: Update Product metadata, visibility, and lifecycle.
productForm.summaryPlaceholder: Describe the capability in one sentence
productForm.publishedTitle: The initial Version will be publishable immediately
productForm.publishedDescription: The current quick-create flow marks the initial Version as published so its Routes can enter a runtime snapshot.

versionForm.description: Manage the version identifier, publication state, and changelog for {product}.

upstreamForm.title: Create Upstream
upstreamForm.description: Define where the Gateway sends real requests. One Upstream can contain multiple Targets.
upstreamForm.editDescription: Update the Upstream name, slug, and load-balancing strategy. Targets and tokens are managed separately.
upstreamForm.loadBalancingHelp: The initial runtime supports round robin and weighted round robin. Weights apply only in weighted mode.
upstreamForm.internalDescription: Caller credentials are removed and the Service Token stored independently for this Upstream is injected before forwarding.
upstreamForm.serviceTokenHelp: The Token is encrypted with the Platform master key and never enters runtime snapshots, ordinary responses, or logs.
upstreamForm.externalDescription: Only HTTPS is allowed. Localhost, private, link-local, and credential-bearing URLs are blocked.
upstreamForm.targetsDescription: Targets must use the same protocol. Weighted mode distributes requests according to each weight.
upstreamForm.multiServiceTitle: One Upstream can connect multiple Service instances
upstreamForm.multiServiceDescription: Targets may run on different servers. Round robin fits equal instances; weighted round robin allocates traffic by capacity. Every Target in one Upstream must belong to the same logical Service and expose matching OpenAPI and configuration schemas.

targetForm.description: Configure the service URL, weight, and traffic state for {upstream}.

routeForm.createDescription: Bind a public Method and Path to an Upstream in the same Workspace.
routeForm.editDescription: Change the public path and governance settings. Platform publishes automatically after save; traffic stays on the previous release if validation fails.
routeForm.namePlaceholder: For example, Get weather by city
routeForm.pathHelp: Supports {'{'}id{'}'} single-segment parameters and {'{'}path+{'}'} trailing wildcard parameters.
routeForm.hostsHelp: Optional. Enter one domain per line or separate them with commas; leave empty to use the Environment default.
routeForm.forwardingDescription: Reference path parameters as {'{'}path.parameter{'}'} in the upstream template. Query parameters and request bodies are forwarded unchanged.
routeForm.upstreamPathHelp: For example, public {'{'}city{'}'} can be referenced as {'{'}path.city{'}'}.
routeForm.governanceDescription: The Platform Gateway applies these rules before forwarding. The API Service never receives caller API keys or manages credits. Zero means unlimited or free.
routeForm.creditsCostHelp: Only successful 2xx/3xx responses are charged. 4xx, 5xx, timeouts, and network failures release reserved credits.
routeForm.catalogStatusHelp: Automatic health uses recent calls; maintenance is shown explicitly in the public catalog.
routeForm.sensitiveQueryHelp: These query parameters are always redacted from call logs and referrers.
routeForm.sensitiveQueryPlaceholder: For example token, then press Enter
routeForm.stateHelp: Only publishable Routes enter the automatically generated runtime snapshot.
routeForm.noVersionsHelp: This Workspace has no publishable Product Versions.
routeForm.noUpstreamsHelp: This Workspace has no available Upstreams.

publish.title: Apply to {environment}
publish.description: Build a complete runtime snapshot from {count} publishable Routes and immediately activate it for this Environment.
publish.descriptionSimple: Build a complete snapshot from the Workspace's publishable Products, Routes, and Upstreams, then activate it for this Environment.

rollback.title: Roll back to runtime snapshot #{sequence}
rollback.description: This immediately switches {environment} to the historical snapshot. The current snapshot remains available and can be restored later.

deleteRoute.title: Delete Route {path}
deleteRoute.description: The Route is soft-deleted from the draft configuration. The active runtime snapshot remains unchanged until the new configuration is applied, and an older snapshot can still restore it.

deleteWorkspace.title: Delete Workspace: {name}
deleteWorkspace.description: Only empty Workspaces can be deleted. The default Workspace and Workspaces with Products, Upstreams, documents, or runtime history are protected.

deleteEnvironment.title: Delete Environment: {name}
deleteEnvironment.description: Only Environments that never produced a runtime snapshot can be deleted. Disable Environments with retained history instead.

deleteProduct.title: Delete Product: {name}
deleteProduct.description: Only Products without Routes and without references from the active runtime snapshot can be deleted.

deleteVersion.title: Delete Version: {version}
deleteVersion.description: Only Versions without Routes and without references from the active runtime snapshot can be deleted.

deleteUpstream.title: Delete Upstream: {name}
deleteUpstream.description: Only Upstreams without Routes and without references from the active runtime snapshot can be deleted.

deleteTarget.title: Delete Target
deleteTarget.description: Ensure the Target is not referenced by an active runtime snapshot and keep at least one available Target for an Upstream that is still in use.

feedback.publishToApply: Apply the new runtime configuration to change traffic
feedback.runtimeUpdated: The Gateway loaded the new configuration without a restart
feedback.savedPendingPublish: The configuration was saved, but automatic publishing failed. Traffic is still using the previous version and the change can be retried from the API catalog
feedback.activateFailed: Failed to roll back the runtime snapshot

serviceControl.pageDescription: Fetch the Service contract and configuration schema automatically. Business configuration remains separate from public Routes, credits, rate limits, and Routing Revisions.
serviceControl.connectionDescription: Discovery means the contract is stored. Runtime status checks both readiness and control-plane authentication for every Target.
serviceControl.replaceTokenDescription: This version cannot accept old and new Tokens together. Coordinate the Service and Platform change in a maintenance window, then rediscover and synchronize configuration.
serviceControl.tokenUpdateFailed: Failed to update the Service Token
serviceControl.rediscoverAfterToken: The connection is pending verification; rediscover and synchronize every Target
serviceControl.discoverySucceeded: Service contract and configuration schema synchronized
serviceControl.discoverFirstDescription: The Platform verifies every Target's Service ID, OpenAPI fingerprint, and configuration schema before enabling the generic form.
serviceControl.configurationDescription: Every field is declared by the Service. The Platform contains no music-, IP-, or crypto-specific form code.
serviceControl.configurationDrifted: Desired configuration saved, but some Targets are not synchronized
serviceControl.secretBoundaryDescription: The browser only receives whether a secret is configured. Plaintext is encrypted at rest and decrypted only while sending it to the Service. Leave empty to preserve the current value.
serviceControl.secretConfiguredPlaceholder: Configured; leave empty to keep unchanged
serviceControl.targetsDescription: Business traffic uses weighting or round robin; configuration updates are always sent to every enabled Target.
serviceControl.endpointsDescription: Discovered {count} business Endpoints. Discovery never creates or publishes public Routes automatically.
serviceControl.noEndpoints: The Service declares no business Endpoints yet

catalog.title: API catalog
catalog.description: Publish an endpoint as soon as a Service is discovered. Publishing, disabling, or governance changes automatically apply the runtime configuration; a new snapshot is saved only when it actually changes.
catalog.contractMissing: This endpoint is no longer present in the Service contract. Review it before disabling or adjusting the Route.

basic.statusDescription: Automatic status measures availability from recent counted requests. Validation, authentication, and other 4xx responses do not mark the API as unhealthy; 5xx responses do. Status remains unknown when statistics are disabled or no samples exist.
